headline: Sensex plunges 989 points as bears take control; Nifty falls below 25,650 dragged by IT and HDFC Bank

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Bears took firm charge of the market on November 27, causing Sensex to plunge 989 points.
Heavy selling pressure in IT stocks and HDFC Bank dragged down the benchmark indices.
Concerns over key domestic sectors and market profit-taking weighed heavily on trader sentiment.
Karnataka issued a show-cause notice to IOC terminal regarding ethanol blending compliance.
whatHappening: Sensex crashed 989 points while Nifty slipped below the 25,650 level during Friday's trading session.
RBI reduced the CRR daily maintenance requirement back to 90% starting from December 1.
SEBI granted approval to eight companies, including Sterlite Electric and Svatantra Microfin, to float IPOs.
MeitY outlined plans to expand national computing infrastructure specifically for AI inference.
summary: Indian equities witnessed a sharp downturn on November 27, with the Sensex plunging 989 points and Nifty falling below 25,650. The market decline was primarily led by heavy drag in IT stocks and HDFC Bank. On the policy front, RBI lowered the CRR daily maintenance requirement to 90% effective December 1.
